title: How to Create Asset with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to create an asset record from a file that was uploaded through a direct upload url, including setup, request fields,…
operation: Create an asset record from a file that was uploaded through a direct upload URL.
prompt: Use Medux to run Create Asset. Review the required inputs, call medux_create_asset, wait for the result if a task is returned, and report the output clearly.

fields.name: category
fields.purpose: Asset category, used for validation and later rendering. Allowed values: - CATEGORY UNDEFINED - Not specified. - MEDIA - Uploaded source media. - AVATAR - Reusable avatar asset. - VOICE - Reusable voice asset.

fields.name: name
fields.purpose: Display name provided by the user. This value may be empty.

fields.name: storage_object.key
fields.purpose: Provide the value described in the API reference.

fields.name: storage_object.url
fields.purpose: Provide the value described in the API reference.
